signals.title: Lwandlana village, outside Mthatha (map point approximate): police sergeant shot dead during an operation, 17 Nov
signals.content: A police sergeant stationed at Mthatha Central police station was shot dead during an early-morning police operation at Lwandlana village outside Mthatha on Tuesday 17 November. According to the Hawks, as relayed by the office of Transport and Community Safety MEC Xolile Nqatha, officers had gone to a home to arrest a person of interest and an occupant opened fire when they knocked. The reports differ on his age (43 or 45) and on whether he died at the scene or in hospital. The suspect was still being sought. The map point is approximate: the Mthatha town point, not the village.

checked.incident: Tue 17 Nov 2026, early hours (Daily Dispatch; Mthatha Express)
checked.location: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. Lwandlana village (the Daily Dispatch says in the Tabase administrative area) outside Mthatha. Neither is in Nominatim near Mthatha (its only "Tabase" is a village in Elundini), so the pin is the Mthatha city point (-31.5896, 28.7878). Area level, about 10 km.

signals.title: Nothintsila, Ngqeleni (map point approximate): police shoot dead three suspected extortionists, 2 Nov
signals.content: Three men police described as suspected extortionists were shot dead in a confrontation with Mthatha Tactical Response Team members on the Nothintsila gravel road, Ngqeleni, at about 10:15 on Monday 2 November, Eastern Cape police spokesperson Brig Nobuntu Gantana said. Police say the officers approached the three men after a tip-off that they were collecting money from local shops, and that the men opened fire; no officers were injured. Three pistols with filed-off serial numbers were recovered. The men had not been identified. IPID was called to investigate the deaths. The map point is approximate: the Ngqeleni town point, not the scene.
